source: The government decided to cut taxes.
correct: The government's decision to cut taxes was announced.
The government made a decision to cut taxes.
explanation: La nominalización convierte un verbo en sustantivo: <decided> → <decision>.

source: They failed to deliver the project on time.
correct: Their failure to deliver the project on time was noted.
The failure to deliver the project on time caused problems.

source: The population grew rapidly in the 20th century.
correct: The rapid growth of the population occurred in the 20th century.
There was rapid growth in the population during the 20th century.

source: Scientists discovered a new species of fish.
correct: The discovery of a new species of fish was made by scientists.
Scientists made the discovery of a new species of fish.

source: The factory pollutes the river heavily.
correct: The heavy pollution of the river by the factory is a concern.
The factory's heavy pollution of the river is problematic.

source: The arrival of the delegation caused a disruption.
correct: When the delegation arrived, it caused a disruption.
The delegation's arriving caused a disruption.
explanation: De-nominalization: <arrival> → <arrived>. Converts back to a verbal clause.

source: We need to improve public transport urgently.
correct: There is an urgent need for the improvement of public transport.
The urgent improvement of public transport is necessary.

source: The company developed new software for hospitals.
correct: The development of new software for hospitals was carried out by the company.
The company's development of new software for hospitals was successful.

source: Employees complained frequently about working conditions.
correct: Frequent complaints about working conditions were made by employees.
There were frequent complaints from employees about working conditions.

source: The president refused to comment on the allegations.
correct: The president's refusal to comment on the allegations was noted.
There was a refusal by the president to comment on the allegations.

source: Researchers investigated the causes of the disease thoroughly.
correct: A thorough investigation of the causes of the disease was conducted.
The thorough investigation into the causes of the disease yielded results.

source: The bridge collapsed unexpectedly during rush hour.
correct: The unexpected collapse of the bridge occurred during rush hour.
The unexpected collapse of the bridge during rush hour shocked everyone.

source: The acquisition of the company was completed last month.
correct: The company was acquired last month.
They acquired the company last month.

source: Students participated enthusiastically in the competition.
correct: The enthusiastic participation of students in the competition was noted.
Students' enthusiastic participation in the competition was impressive.

source: The authorities responded quickly to the crisis.
correct: The quick response of the authorities to the crisis was effective.
There was a quick response by the authorities to the crisis.

source: Technology has advanced significantly in recent years.
correct: The significant advancement of technology in recent years is evident.
There has been significant advancement in technology in recent years.

source: The committee recommended that they hire more staff.
correct: The committee's recommendation was to hire more staff.
The committee made a recommendation to hire more staff.

source: The implementation of the new policy faced resistance.
correct: Implementing the new policy faced resistance.
When they implemented the new policy, they faced resistance.

source: Sales increased dramatically after the advertising campaign.
correct: There was a dramatic increase in sales after the advertising campaign.
The dramatic increase in sales followed the advertising campaign.

source: The two companies collaborated on the project successfully.
correct: The successful collaboration between the two companies on the project was praised.
There was successful collaboration between the two companies on the project.
